tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient probe resolves the ambiguity left by the pilot. The fitted law subtracts a loss proportional to u_now and the gradient excess above an onset near 2.534. It reproduces all eight paid observations to their reported precision and is ready for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The physical Haldane model stays nonnegative and depends only on u_now, so it cannot explain the negative high-gradient responses.
A single multiplicative power law cannot change sign across these positive inputs.
The five pilot rows identify the baseline terms, and the three high-gradient rows identify the onset and loss coefficient. Another paid batch is not needed before fresh confirmation.
